_meta.legal_basis: Companies Act 2013 Section 4 read with Schedule I
_meta.notes: MOA is the charter document of a company. Six mandatory clauses under S.4(1). Tables A-E of Schedule I prescribe formats. Doctrine of ultra vires applies (Lakshmanaswami Mudaliar v. LIC AIR 1963 SC 1185). Alteration requires special resolution and Central Government approval for objects clause in some cases.

title: Memorandum of Association

company_name.title: Proposed Company Name (must end with 'Limited' or 'Private Limited')

subscribers.title: Subscribers (minimum 2 for Pvt, 7 for Public, 1 for OPC)

mandatory_clauses.title: I. Name Clause
mandatory_clauses.content: The name of the Company is {{company_name}}.

mandatory_clauses.title: II. Registered Office Clause
mandatory_clauses.content: The Registered Office of the Company will be situated in the State of {{registered_office_state}}.

mandatory_clauses.title: III. Objects Clause
subclauses: A. The objects to be pursued by the Company on its incorporation
B. Matters considered necessary in furtherance of the main objects
mandatory_clauses.note: Ultra vires acts are void per Lakshmanaswami Mudaliar v. LIC.

mandatory_clauses.title: IV. Liability Clause
mandatory_clauses.content: The liability of the Members is {{liability_type}}.

mandatory_clauses.title: V. Capital Clause
mandatory_clauses.content: The Authorized Share Capital of the Company is INR {{authorized_capital}} divided into {{number_of_shares}} Equity Shares of INR {{face_value_per_share}} each.

mandatory_clauses.title: VI. Association and Subscription Clause
mandatory_clauses.content: We, the several persons whose names and addresses are subscribed below, are desirous of being formed into a Company in pursuance of this Memorandum of Association, and we respectively agree to take the number of shares in the capital of the Company set against our respective names.

prompt_context.system_role: You are drafting a Memorandum of Association under Companies Act 2013 Section 4 read with Schedule I (Tables A-E). All six mandatory clauses must be present in order. Use formal corporate drafting language. Objects must be specific and lawful.
drafting_rules: Strictly follow Table A format for company limited by shares (or Table B/C/D/E as applicable).
Name clause: must end with 'Limited' (public) or 'Private Limited' (private). Avoid prohibited words under Rule 8 of Cos (Incorporation) Rules 2014.
Objects clause: Split into 'Main Objects' (what company will do on incorporation) and 'Matters necessary for furtherance'. Be specific - avoid vague catch-alls.
Capital clause: state authorized capital, division into shares, face value.
Subscriber table at end - minimum 2 for Pvt, 7 for Public, 1 for OPC.
Each subscriber must subscribe to at least one share.
Mention witness with full address and occupation.
prompt_context.tone: Formal, archaic corporate-legal English consistent with Schedule I format.

sections: State stamp duty on MOA per Schedule I-A

filing_checklist: File with SPICe+ (INC-32) along with AOA, INC-9 (declaration), DIR-2 (consent), proof of registered office.
Stamp duty paid per state Stamp Act (varies by authorized capital).
DSC of all subscribers and witness.
Name approval via RUN/SPICe+ Part A before filing.

validation_rules.rule: Each subscriber subscribes to at least 1 share

validation_rules.check: Must end with 'Limited' or 'Private Limited' or 'OPC Private Limited'

validation_rules.rule: Authorized capital >= total subscribed shares * face value

validation_rules.check: name, registered_office, objects, liability, capital, association
